$comment: HOW A PLAN LOOKS — the second half of the shared plan card, and the half that is not CSS.
Authored on the MARKETING SITE and transcribed here by hand, exactly like
src/styles/plan-card.css. Together the two files are the whole look of a plan card.
CORRECTED 02.09.2026: this header used to say the pair is "copied into the marketing site by
its scripts/sync-plan-card.mjs". THERE IS NO SUCH FILE, in either repository — checked in both
on 02.09.2026. The sentence had been read as a guarantee that the two surfaces could not drift,
and they drifted three times while it stood. The transcription is manual. It has to be REDONE
when the marketing site moves; it does not keep itself true.
WHAT IS IN HERE IS SHAPE, NOT TEXT. Prices and quotas come from the database — get_public_plan_
catalogue() and get_public_plan_quotas() — because ARCHITECTURE.md:244 forbids a pricing plan
hidden in code, and that rule does not stop being true for a file that calls itself shared.
Marketing prose stays on each surface in its own language: the marketing site publishes he, en
and fr, the product publishes he and en, and a file that tried to hold all of it would be a
translation system pretending to be a design token.
What each plan gets from here: which of the five faces it wears and which lucide glyph names it.
Both are drawing decisions, and both used to live in a component on one surface only.
`business` IS PRESENT AND THE PRODUCT SURFACES STILL WILL NOT SHOW IT. get_public_plan_
catalogue() excludes it in the server (#194/#201), so the public ladder never receives a row to
draw; the authenticated panel does receive one. Its face is here so that the one surface allowed
to render it draws the same card as everything else, not so that a second surface may start.
WHICH RUNG THE VENDOR POINTS AT — AND WHY THE MARKETING SITE DECIDED IT.
The two surfaces disagreed. The marketing site pointed at PRO; the product's PLAN_EMPHASIS
pointed at PREMIUM, per OPEN-DECISIONS #202 («ופרימיום הוא הנחשק ביותר»). Two surfaces pointing
a visitor at two different plans is exactly the drift this file exists to end.
Owner ruling 27.08.2026, asked directly and answered directly: «תיישר לפי הדף נחיתה». PRO takes
the pointer. This SUPERSEDES the emphasis half of #202 — recorded in OPEN-DECISIONS #296 so the
next reader meets the current answer rather than re-deriving the old one from a row that is no
longer true. The rest of #202 is untouched and still binds: the emphasis is STATIC and identical
for every reader, never keyed to the tenant's own data and never a personal recommendation.
RE-FACED 02.09.2026, WITH THE CARD. The marketing site rebuilt this chapter on 01.09.2026
("ROUND 20") and renamed every face that is an object. `pointed`, `azure` and `deep` are gone:
פרו now wears `framed` — a slate body inside a grey surround, which is where its whole emphasis
now lives — פרימיום wears `magenta`, and ביזנס wears `slate`, a quiet dark plate. `plain` and
`lift` are unchanged: they are the page's ground and that ground raised a step.
THE SHADER RAMP IS GONE, and so is `PlanShader.tsx`. It painted a WebGL field behind the `deep`
card. The marketing site removed it in the same round and said why: «a second GL context for one
card in a closed tab is a cost with no reader.» There is no face left that carries a field.
